checks.detail: the overlap Itilde = int (a^2 + b^2) rho_f e^{-3Hy} dy of the dark-matter level with the Standard-Model zero modes equals the derivative of the self-consistent Kohn-Sham level with respect to the I11 amplitude (finite differences at 1e-4 and 2e-4, Richardson) to 3.1e-10: Q 8.272211, e_R 0.397153, L 1.252406; fold band: Q 6.685235, L 1.659210, e_R 8.0805e-01
checks.name: C1_overlaps

checks.detail: in the interacting Kohn-Sham state (8 fold zero modes and 8 dark-matter quanta, lambda_B) the response of the dark-matter level to the quark-doublet I11 field is 8.269322 against the bare overlap 8.272211 (relative -3.49e-04): the self-consistent screening by the Psi gas is small
checks.name: C1_screened_response

checks.detail: with the lepton-doublet I11 field the spacing between the k = 0 fold zero mode and the first momentum shell changes by -1.1e-10 per unit amplitude at first order (second order -0.041 e^2, a change of the group velocity: the ratio of the energies of the shells |k| = 2 dk and dk above the zero mode stays 2.000000000, 2.000000000, 2.000000000, i.e. the dispersion stays linear); at the physical amplitudes (below 1e-40 in these units) the fold band is massless
checks.name: C1_fold_band_massless

checks.detail: f fbar -> Psi_fold Psibar_fold through I11 (B - L): gamma = (4/pi^5) N_chi sum N_c (q Itilde)^2 G_V^2 T^8 (Maxwell-Boltzmann; Bessel moments 384 and 3072 checked), each pair carrying 8T; sum N_c (q Itilde)^2 = 1.2685e+02 over the Weyl components of three generations; Delta N_eff = 5.212e+29 G_V^2 GeV^4 for T_max = 10 TeV, so the benchmark Delta N_eff = 1e-3 means G_V = 4.380e-17 GeV^-2 (3.8e-12 G_F); Delta N_eff = 8.00e-06, 1.25e-04, 1.00e-03, 8.00e-03 for T_max = 2, 5, 10, 20 TeV; at T_max the production rate per fold quantum is 1.2e-02 of the Hubble rate: the fold bands are never in equilibrium
checks.name: C2_freeze_in_benchmark

checks.detail: the benchmark I11 couples the dark matter coherently to the quark vector currents (f_p = 2 G_u + G_d = 1.897e-16 GeV^-2, f_n = 1.898e-16 GeV^-2): sigma_n = mu^2 f^2/pi = 3.9e-60 cm^2 for xenon, against the LZ limit 2.4e-45 cm^2
checks.name: C3_direct_detection_I11

checks.detail: a mean field on the b-component, (1 - gamma^(x0))/2 v_b(y) = (1 - sigma3)/2 v_b(y), shifts the dark-matter level by Itilde^(b) = int b^2 rho_f e^{-3Hy} dy (self-consistent Kohn-Sham solutions, Richardson in the amplitude, agreement 2.3e-10: Q 2.613454, L 0.913410, u_R 0.379455) and leaves the fold zero mode and the first fold shell unchanged to 6.8e-14: I13 does not act on the fold bands
checks.name: C8_I13_overlaps_and_fold_band

checks.detail: with the unitarity-safe I12 benchmark and the s-wave portal I13 (baryon-number current, sum N_c (q Itilde^(b))^2 = 16.351 over the quark Weyl components) each species leaves Omega h^2 = 0.060 for G_A = 1.269e-09 GeV^-2 if the effective cross-section held at every energy (x_f = 31.23; <sigma v>(x_f): I13 9.500e-26, I12 9.906e-28 cm^3/s); that cross-section reaches the J = 1 bound sigma <= 3 pi/(4 p^2) (one channel, 3S1) above v = 0.52, which carries 24.5 % of the rate at freeze-out; with the cross-section capped at the bound the relic needs G_A = 1.278e-09 GeV^-2 (1.1e-04 G_F; x_f = 31.23), and 19.0 % of the freeze-out rate then comes from collisions at the bound (v > 0.51): the relic is reached with most annihilations in the perturbative regime
checks.name: C8_I13_relic

checks.detail: I13 and I11 couple the dark matter coherently to the quark vector currents: f_p = 1.915e-09, f_n = 1.917e-09 GeV^-2, sigma_n = mu^2 f^2/pi = 4.01e-46 cm^2 for xenon, 0.16 of the LZ limit 2.44e-45 cm^2 at 44.3 TeV: allowed, and within reach of the next generation of xenon detectors; annihilation today (s-wave, into quark pairs) sigma v = sum N_c G_f^2 M^2/(2 pi) = 9.76e-26 cm^3/s
checks.name: C8_I13_direct_detection

checks.detail: with the B - L current instead of J^B, I13 would need G_A = 1.072e-09 GeV^-2 (sum N_c (q Itilde^(b))^2 = 22.92; the three nu_R carry 1.2 % of the annihilation) and chi chibar <-> nu_R nubar_R would bring the right-handed neutrinos into equilibrium: from zero abundance at M/T = 2 they reach 0.9997 of the equilibrium number by M/T = 40; the number-changing rate falls below the Hubble rate at M/T = 16.1 and elastic scattering on the dark matter at M/T = 25.1 (T = 1769 GeV, g_s = 105.74); the three nu_R would then add Delta N_eff = 3 (10.75/g_s)^(4/3) F_h = 0.144, N_eff = 3.187, 2.5 standard deviations above ACT DR6 (2.86 +- 0.13): hence I13 couples to the baryon-number current, which leaves the nu_R untouched
checks.name: C9_B_minus_L_alternative_thermalises_nuR

checks.detail: the QCD scale tracks the block exponentially: with alpha_s(m_KK) = 0.0606 proportional to f^-4 and m_KK ~ 1/f, d ln Lambda^(6)/d ln f = -1 - (2 pi/(7 alpha_s)) 4 = -60.2; through the c, b, t thresholds d ln Lambda^(3)/d ln f = -49.0; with the sigma terms d ln m_p/d ln f = -46.1 (ESTIMATE, one loop): the nucleon mass is the most block-sensitive mass of UM-2
checks.name: C6_proton_sensitivity

checks.detail: the Standard-Model mean fields shift the dark-matter level by at most 1.6e-06 of its mass over the ten environments (largest: dark-matter freeze-out (T = 1.46 TeV), where the thermal gauge condensates are of order T^4; at most 1.0e-16 from nucleosynthesis to today) (I11 from the quark and electron B - L densities, I13 from the quark baryon-number densities, each with its x0 profiles; I12 from the QCD vacuum condensate, the thermal QCD interaction measure and the thermal W, Z condensates); the fold band stays massless
checks.name: C4_mean_fields_in_environments

checks.detail: hidden pressures of nucleons (d ln m_p/d ln f = -46.1), electrons and dark matter shift the block by at most delta ln f = 5.6e-45 (nucleon mass 2.6e-43) in the ten environments; the gain of the loop mass -> hidden pressure -> block -> mass is at most 1.3e-44, so the self-consistent iteration converges at once
checks.name: C6_gravity_loop

checks.detail: with the kinetic function 1 + e s_DM(y) (s_DM = 2ab of the dark-matter orbital) the W eigenvalue changes by d ln Lambda_W/de = -0.1126 (finite elements, Richardson in e), i.e. m_W follows the 4D coupling, while the photon (and gluon) zero mode stays exactly massless (Lambda = -2.5e-11 with e = 0.01); the relevant amplitude in the environments is e ~ 4 c g^2 n_DM/Lambda*^3 < 1e-50
checks.name: C5_WZ_and_photon

checks.detail: the gauge-kinetic portal of the benchmark changes the strong coupling by 10 % through the thermal dark-matter density at T = 27359 GeV (M/T = 1.62): the coupled effective description holds below this temperature, i.e. through dark-matter freeze-out (M/T = 31) and everything later; the benchmark I12 respects the 3P0 unitarity bound up to sqrt(s) = 2.40 M (an I12 of the relic strength of version 2 would violate it above v = 0.274), and I13 reaches its J = 1 bound only above v = 0.51
checks.name: C7_validity_domain

description: UM-2 coupled solution: Kohn-Sham theory for dirac16complex coupled to gravity and to every Standard-Model field, in environments from the laboratory to neutron stars and the early Universe
